about: The secreta of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Sanctify, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the gifts offered, and cleanse our hearts by the illumination of the Holy Ghost. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
